par byas yod/kho'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos gtso che shos ni mi dang mi'i bar gyi rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'brel ba 'bri 'god kyis mi sna'i rang gshis nyams zhan du btang ba de red/ kho'i brtsams chos khrod kyi 'jig rten ni rtsom pa po mang pos 6 bdag nyid ’’lte bar byas te bskrun pa dang mi 'dra bar ‘ bdag nyid mi dang sna mi gzhan sa zhes do snang byed pa'i mdo gnad gnyis yod pa dang / 4‘bdag nyid ’ ni ‘6mi gzhan ’’gyi rin thang lta ba mi 'dra ba dang dpyad bsdur byas pa las mngon 'gyur byung ba zhig red/ khos bskrun bzhengs bgyis pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan mang che ba bya ba sgrub skabs grung sha ldan la nyams myong nges can yod pa'i mi dar ma yin/ rtsom pa pos gsar rtsom gyi brgyud rim nang mtshon bya'i bya dngos dang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i ma dbyibs gnyis dbar ched mngags tshad gzhi nges can gyi tshul ldog gi rnam pa zhig 'grub pa byas yod/ho'u theng ming hreng la u ru su'i rtsom pa po ku'o ko li dang thu'o si thu'o ye h+phu si ci sogs kyi shugs rkyen zab mo phog pas/ slob 'bring nas slob che'i bar thog mtha' bar gsum du ku'o ko li'i brtsams sgrung ni kho'i dga' shos kyi klog deb cig yin/ de nas o si khru'i rtsom pa po kha h+phu kha'i shugs rkyen yang thebs yod pa dang / slob grwa chen mo ba'i skabs kho'i 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa'i brtsams chos bklags rjes kha h+phu khar blo kha phyogs shing / gsar rtsom skabs kha h+phu kha'i brtsams chos nang mi sna gtso bo de ‘‘5 ’zhes pa'i brda rtags shig tu bsdus bris bya thabs la dpyad gzhi byas pa mthong thub/chung dus kho re yar 'tsho ba bskyal ba'i gnas tshul da lta'i bar dran shes su wa ler 'char gyin yod pas/ 〈gnyid lab rgyag pa 〉(1975)zhes pa'i 1472

brtsams chos ring gras de ni de'i skabs kyi 'tsho ba'i myong brgyud las rgyu cha blangs pa zhig yin/ kho'i gtso bo'i brtsams chos gras su da dung 〈gad mo'i dmyal ba 〉(1969)zhes pa'i bcoms sgrung phyogs bsdus dang / 〈blum zhing 'jong ba'i 'jig rten 〉(1972)zer ba'i thol rtsom phyogs bsdus kyang yod do/nyi ma'i rigs dang dwangs gsal rigs kyi rtsom rig492 ji 'dra zhig la nyi ma'i rigs dang dwangs gsal rigs kyi rtsom rig zer ram/nyi ma'i rigs kyi rtsom rig dang dwangs gsal rigs kyi rtsom rig ni 'jar pan rtsom rig khrod kyi deng rabs smra ba'i grub mtha' zhig red/nyi ma'i rigs kyi rtsom rig ni dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs lnga bcu par byung yod/ hri yon hren tha'e lang gis 'grems spel byas pa'i brtsams sgrung 'bring gras 〈nyi ma'i dus tshigs 〉(1955)zhes pa der rtsom rig las rigs su rlung rlabs chen po g.yos shing bstod smad ci rigs kyi rtsod gzhi rgyun chad med par thon yod/ brtsams sgrung der khu tshur snun pa'i lus rtsal la dga' zhen byed mkhan slob phrug lung tsa'o dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi sras mo ying tsi gnyis po'i brtse grogs kyi gtam rgyud srog shing du bzung ste na gzhon tsho'i mtshams tshad med pa'i bag med rnam g.yeng gi 'tsho ba yongs khyab ngang mtshon par byas shing dus rabs dang / yul srol/ kun spyod sogs kyi gnad don la gzhi rgya chen pos 'brel ba byas yod/ na gzhon de tshos ra mi rgan pa ’ tsho'i kun spyod lta bar sun snang dang / bag med rgya yan du spyod pa'i lus po'i bya spyod kyis der gtor bshig gtong ba'i thog nas kun spyod kyi lta ba gsar 1473

pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa dang / brtse dung gsar pa'i rang bzhin 'tshol zhib byed pa bcas ni brtsams chos de'i brjod bya gtso bo red/ hri yon gyis dngos yod la yid mi tshim pa dang / sems nus kyis khengs pa'i na gzhon tshos spyi tshogs kyi khrod du rang gi nus rtsal 'don spel bya rgyu'i brel ba byed rung 66rdab rdeb gtong sa'i gyang mi’zhig mi rnyed pa'i skor bris yod pa 'di ni g.yo lhad med pa'i stabs bde'i spro sems tsam dang / dmigs tshad med pa'i don stong ring lugs dang nye ba'i spro sems shig yin pa'i skor rtsom pa pos kyang tag tag 〈khrims gcod khang 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos nang 4(spyi tshogs 'di ni khang chung zhig dang mtshungs pas dbugs gtong len dka'/ nga tsho 'tshang kha shig shig ngang 'dir sdod dgos pa dang ngas nus shugs yod tshad bton te de nyid 'bud rgyag gtong bsams na'ang ci ltar 'bud rgyag gtong dgos pa mi shes la/ 'bud rgyag gtong sa gang yin min yang mi shes ri zhes bkod yod pa ltar red/ bsam blo'i brtse dung 'di skabs der bzo pa'i las 'gul dang slob grwa ba'i las 'gul tshang ma dma' rlabs su gnas pa'i skabs kyi gzhon nu khag gcig gi bsam pa'i gnas stangs dang 'tshams thub pa byung bas kho tsho'i thun mong gi mnyam grags byung ba red/ ma gzhi 'khyog bcos yin la blo khog kyang chen pos 64rang gis byed 'dod shos kyi las ka byed dgos ’ zhes pa'i 'dod tshul bton pa des rang don sbug 'tshang dang / dbang nus kyi longs spyod/ bdag nyid blo yid khengs pa'i rang don ring lugs bcas don gnyer byed pa zhig yin pas 'di ni 'jar pan ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor 46tshad myur 'phel rgyas ’ 'gro ba'i 'og gi bsam pa'i 'du shes kyi cung snga ba'i mtshon tshul zhig red ces shod chog der brten skabs der tshags par las rigs kha cig gis hri yon ni gzhon nu'i 1474

dpa' bor 'ud bstod dang / tha na 46nyi ma'i rigs mi’zhes pa de dar bzo che ba'i skad cha zhig tu gyur la/ hri yon gyi skra'i bzo lta de'ang re zhig dar srol che ba zhig tu gyur pa red/ 6 nyi ma'i rigs :’zhes pa de ni bya spyod la mnyam 'jog mi byed mkhan gzhon nu spyir 'god kyi yod la/ de nyid rtsom rig gi grub mtha' zhig gi ngos nas cha bzhag na/ re zhig rang zlas bud sgrog che ba'i gzhon nu de tsho'i nyams smad kyi bsam pa'i mngon tshul tsam yin/lo rabs bdun cu par bskyod rjes 64nyi ma'i rigs mi kyi nyams smad rtsom rig gis dus rabs gsar pa'i cha rkyen 'og gting zab tu song ba'i rnam pa'i thog nas phya dwangs gsal rigs ri’kyi rtsom rig 'dren par byas/ ra dwangs gsal rigs ’ kyi rtsom rig ces pa'i ming 'di ni na gzhon rtsom pa po tshun hrang lung gi 〈ha lam tshad med dwangs gsal gyi sngon po 〉(1976)zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung las thogs shing / brtsams sgrung der mi sna gtso bo 'brug zer ba zhig dang gzhon nu skor zhig a rag tshod med 'thung zhing dug rdzas 'then pa dang 'dod pa gang byung du spyod pa'i bag med 'tsho ba'i skor bris yod/brtsams chos hril po byung rim med par rmi lam 'phrul snang lta bu zhig yin mod/ tshod med 'khrig sbyor gyi bya spyod skor la yig tshogs mang ba'i zhib 'bri byas pa 'di lta bu'i brtsams chos la 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dpyad brjod pa tshos 'jar pan deng rabs rtsom rig gi ‘4rtse mo gsar pa ’ zhes 'ud sgrog gis ce khron bya dga' sprad pas/ des rkyen pas dpyad 'dems u yon yung cing lung nan yang khong khro chen pos dgongs zhu byas/ grub mtha' 'dis na gzhon rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gis deng rabs kyi 6 bkag sdom spyi tshogs sa la 'khang ra byed pa dang / ‘‘nang gtad rtsom rig ’’la'ang sun snang byed pa'i bsam pa mtshon yod/ kho tshos bying nyob kyi gnas stangs 'di med pa bzo 1475

rgyu'i ched du nang don dang rnam pa gang thad nas cis kyang khyad 'phags gsar spel dang / 'jar pan rtsom rig gi sngar yod srol rgyun gtor zhing bdag nyid kyi langs phyogs gzhir bzung lho‘bsam blo rang dbang mi’dang / ‘‘rang gshis bcings 'grol ’/ tha na 46'khrig spyod kyi mthar phyin pa'i bcings 'grol 〉’zer ba sogs don gnyer dang / ‘ blang dor ma yin ’ pa'i rnam pa ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom bya thabs la brten nas bdag nyid kyi mnar gcod dang / don stong gi re zad/ tshul ldo ga gi sems khams bcas mngon pa byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ krung hran can tsho'i 〈ri gnyis kyi bar 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos nas 'go tshugs te/ tshun hrang lung gi 〈ha lam tshad med dwangs gsal gyi sngon po 〉zhes pa dang / khri then man hro'u h+phu'i 〈a'e chin ha'e la 'bul rgyu 〉〉zhes pa'i bar gyi brtsams chos kyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gsar pa ste dwangs gsal rigs grub pa yin/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig de dag gi thun mong khyad chos ni 'tsho bar re ba zad pa dang / bsam blo stong par gyur pa/ spyi tshogs la yid ches shor ba/ dngos yod de smyo ba lta bu dang / zing cha che ba/ nag khung nag rkyang bcas su rtsi ba/ mi rnams rang nus kyi ngar shugs tsam ldan pa'i srog chags shig tu lta ba dang / 66'chi khar slebs pa'i tshor snang ’ zhig mngon pa/ blang dor dang blang dor bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa khas mi len par tshor snang dang mngon sum ang dang por 'jog pa/ gsal kha dod pa'i brjod bya gtso bo dang 'brel chags kyi byung rim med pa bcas dang / nang don khungs lung med la/ rnam pa ya mtshan che ba/ rjod tshig btsog pa bcas yin no/1476

stong bsam kyal rtsed smra ba/493 ji 'dra zhig la stong bsam kyal rtsed smra ba zer ram/‘ kyal rtsed ’’ces pa 'di ni 'jar pan gyi nye rabs dus dkyil du byung ba'i tha snyad cig yin pa dang thog gyad mi dang dpe cha bas gzhas gtong ba dang snyan ngag 'don klog gi bar gseng khom dus gsar rtsom byed pa'i go bde'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la zer ba dang / rjes su grong mi dpe cha bas mang tshogs la spro snang 'byin rgyu dmigs yul du bzung nas gsar rtsom byed pa'i go bde'i brtsams sgrung brtsams chos la zer ba 'dir ku re'i rang bzhin zab mo ldan yod/ stong bsam kyal rtsed smra ba zhes pa ni lo rabs drug cu pa'i snga rjes su thon zhing mang tshogs la spro ba ster rgyu dmigs yul du byed pa'i tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung dang dgod bro'i brtsams sgrung gi rtsom pa por zer/ kho tsho'i gsar rtsom gyis ya mtshan che ba'i byung rim dang phun sum tshogs pa'i bsam bkod don gnyer byed cing de'i khrod du gtan tshigs gnas lugs dang 'gal ba'ang yod/ tshab mtshon rtsom pa por —thung cing khang lung dang ci hrang zha sogs yod pa red/ kho tsho ni rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i rig gnas tshogs pa zhig ma yin par gsar rtsom thad tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung dang go bde'i brtsams sgrub gi bya thabs g.yar spyod byed pa tsam yin/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos khrod du dngos yod las brgal ba'i ljongs bkod de 'dra rtag tu mthong rgyu yod la tshul 'chal gyi nang don brgyud dus rabs kyi zhan char 'phya smod byed kyin yod/1477

494 thung cing khang lung ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/thung cing khang lung ni deng skabs 'jar pan gyi tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang (stong bsam )brtsams sgrung dang dgod bro'i brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po shugs rkyen che shos ldan pa zhig red/ kho'i brtsams chos ni bsam bkod phun sum tshogs la/ byung rim gyi rang bzhin che ba dang / mi rnams kyi blo 'gugs thub la/ tshul 'chal dgod bro'i byung rim gyi phyi gos 'og deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi gnad don rab dang rim par shugs drag che ba'i 'phya smod dang rno ngar ldan pa'i sun 'byin byed pa zhig yin/kho pa 1934lor 'jar pan ta pan du skyes pa dang / pha ni srog chags rig pa ba zhig yin zhing grong khyer ta pan gyis btsugs pa'i rang byung tshan rig dngos mang bshams ston khang gi 'go 'dzin byed myong yod/ pha'i slob ston 'og chung dus nas rang byung tshan rig gi shes bya mang po khong du chud/slob 'bring slob grwa ba'i skabs zlos gar dang glog brnyan la dga' po yod pa ma zad zur za'i ri mor yang dga' po yod/ 1953lor thung kri hre'i slob cher zhugs nas mdzes rig dang sgyu rtsal slob sbyong byas pas ma tshad kha h+phu kha dang / ha'e ming we/ h+phu lu'o dbyi te sogs la rig pa gcig bsgrims kyis zhib 'jug byas/ 1957lor slob grwa chen mo thon rjes na'e tshun bzo rtsal hrer las kur zhugs shing las zhor du glog brnyan 'khrab gzhung gi gsar rtsom la gzhol/ 1960lor gcung po tsho dang lhan cig tu 〈ngag 'khyal 〉zhes pa'i tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung gi dus deb gnyer/ de'i phyi lo kung si'i las gnas dgongs zhu byas pa dang / /964lor 'jar pan gyi /478

skabs gsum pa'i tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung gi tshogs chen skong tshogs byed pa'i gtso 'gan 'khur/ lo der 'jar pan gyi tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po'i spro skyid khang gi khongs su zhugs/ 1965lor 〈shar rgya mtsho'i mtsho lam gyi dmag 'khrug 〉ces pa'i thengs dang po'i brtsams sgrung thung gras phyogs bsdus dang / 〈dung phyur bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyi stong bsam 〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras bcas par du bskrun/ 1967lo'i rjes su 〈le the nam gyi lta skor kung hre 〉(1967)dang / 〈dkyus dngos ri mo gsal 'grel 〉(1971—1972)zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras dang / 〈khyim rgyud 'byor 'phel 〉(1972)zhes pa'i mu 'brel brtsams sgrung thung gras bcas par du bskrun/thung cing khang lung gis tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom byed pa ni tshan rig shes bya khyab gdal btang nas mi rnams kyi rang byung tshan rig gi spro snang 'phel thabs kyi ched du yin pa tsam ma zad/dmigs yul gtso bo ni tshan rig gi 'phel rgyas kyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i shugs rkyen la do snang dang / cha mi snyom pa'i mi'i rigs kyi shes rig 'phel rgyas la dogs 'dri byed pa de yin/kho'i brtsams chos ni bsam bkod blo rgya che ba dang / tshul 'chal/ ku re'i rang bzhin shugs che ldan pa bcas mang che ba klog pa po'i spro snang 'phel thabs dang skyo ba bsangs ched gsar rtsom byas pa zhig red/ lo rabs bdun cu'i dus dkyil tshun du kho'i brtsams chos la 'jar pan dpyad gtam las rigs dang rtsom pa po mang pos do snang chen po byas yod pa de ni brtsams chos kyi blo bkod ya mtshan che la 'gyur ldog mang ba/ bsam pa'i bkod shugs kyi nus pa gang legs 'don spel byas pa bcas kyis yin no/1479

495 〈shar rgya mtsho'i mtsho lam gyi dmag 'khrug 〉ces pa de brtsams chos ji 'dra zhig red dam/brtsams sgrung 'bring gras 〈shar rgya mtsho'i mtsho lam gyi dmag 'khrug 〉〉ces pa de ni 'jar pan gyi brtsams sgrung ba thung cing khang lung gi tshab mtshon brtsams chos yin zhing 1965lo'i zla 7par 〈tshan rig 'char snang brtsams sgrung dus deb 〉thog 'grems spel byas/brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo 6‘bdag nyid ’’kyis zhogs pa mig gdangs nas sge'u khung phyi rol du lta skabs phyi phyogs su dmag rgyag gi med dam snyam pa byung yang dmag langs/ pa'i rgyu rkyen dang dgra bo su yin mi shes/6‘bdag nyid mi’rlung 'phrin kung sir slebs skabs da gzod tho khe'o dang ta pan grong khyer gnyis dbar dmag 'khrug langs pa shes/ rgyu rkyen ni ta pan gyis tho khe'o ru dpung 'jug byed pa'i gsar 'gyur spel bas red/ g.yul sa mdun mar 6‘bdag nyid ’ kyis brtse grogs pang tsi mthong / kho mo dmag la gzhug rtsis byas kyang me sgyogs dang gnam gru'i mdel char phog kho mos dmag sa nas kha bral rtsis byed skabs khrab ldan 'khor lo'i 'gog rgol phog ste dmag sar grongs/ 66bdag nyid ’’kyang khrab ldan 'khor lo'i phyogs su bskyod skabs skyogs mdel gyis srog dbang 'phroga'adir rtsom pa pos rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin sogs gsar 'gyur sgrog spel gyi yo byad 'phel rgyas myur po byung ba des mi'i rin thang gi lta bar 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / cha 'phrin gyi dngos bden rang bzhin gyis rtag tu don rkyen ngo ma de rang mar mnan pa/ 'byung 'gyur gyi spyi tshogs khrod du gal te spyi byings kyi gsar 'gyur sgrog spel byas thabs la go 'dzol byung tshe chag sgo 1480

chen po yong nges yin pa bcas bstan phyir yin/ brtsams chos kyi byung rim ya mtshan che la tshul 'chal 'dra ba'i nang don gyi khrod du deng rabs shes rig las byung ba'i skyon char sems khral byas yod/496 cing hrang zha ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/cing hran zha ni deng skabs 'jar pan gyi skad grags che ba'i brtsams sgrung ba dang 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa po zhig yin/ lo rabs drug cur ming grags 'phel zhing snga dus zlos gar gsar rtsom byed kyi yod/ lo rabs drug cu'i dus dkyil nas bzung brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom byas pa dang / stong bsam kyal rtsed smra ba'i rtsom pa po'i gras su gtogs/kho pa 1935lor 'jar pan hran zhing rdzong du skyes/ chung dus nas pha grongs pas a ma dang gcen pos tshong rgyag pa dang mi lag rgyugs pa sogs byas te mi tshe bskyal/ slob 'bring du slob sbyong byed skabs brnyan par klog rgyu dang glog brnyan lta rgyur dga' po yod/ 1950lor gnam bdag chos lugs kyi dbang mnos/ 1953lor hrang kri slob che'i 'jar man gyi rtsom rig tshan khag tu slob sbyong dang rjes su h+pha ran si'i skad yig tshan khag tu slob sbyong byed ring zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston pa gcig lcogs byas pas gar stegs kyi bya las la rgyus mnga' ldan/ slob grwa chen mo thon rjes bang mdzod bdag gnyer gyi las ka dang / 1964lor mi gzhan dang mnyam du 〈stabs legs kyi ka bed gling phran 〉(1970)zhes pa'i 'khrab gzhung gsar rtsom byas nas ming grags 'phel/ kho'i 'khrab gzhung la dgod bro bstan bshig slong byed kyi grub cha mang du ldan zhing tshab mtshon brtsams chos su 〈ta'o kri'i nyen mchong 〉(1970)zer ba sogs yod/ lo rabs bdun cur brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom 1481

dang de dag la rang gi dgod bro'i nyams 'gyur rgyun 'khyodas byas/ 1971lor 〈sems pas lag pa bsdams pa 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung 'bring gras shig gsar rtsom byas pa de ni cang hu'u'i dus rabs las rgyu cha blangs shing der go bde'i brtsams sgrung rtsom nga/ po cin sung yus dbyi'i 'tsho ba'i skor bkod yod la/ dus rabs kyi rnam pa dang spyod tshul mtshon par byas/ de'i phyi lo brtsams chos der kri mu'u'i bya dga' thob/ 1981lor tshab mtshon brtsams chos 〈ci li ci li ba 〉zhes pa par du bskrun/ brtsams chos der 'jar pan byang shar khul du ‘‘ci li ci li rgyal khab ’’ces pa'i rang btsan rgyal khab chung chung zhig glo bur du thon pa la 'jar pan srid gzhung sems 'tshab chen po skyes te rang srung ru khag mngags nas rgyal khab de'i mtha' bskor ba dang /gsang myul brdzangs nas mgo rting slog rgyu'i bya ba spel mthar ci li ci li rgyal khab rtsa brlag tu song ba'i gnas tshul bkod yod/ brtsams chos kyi byung rim mang che ba rtog bzo yin zhing 'jar pan dang ci li ci li rgyal khab gnyis dpyad bsdur byas pa'i thog nas 'jar pan spyi tshogs kyi lugs mthun min pa'i snang tshul la sun 'byin byas yod/cing hrang zha'i brtsams chos la gad mo har sgra shor dgos pa'i bstan bshig dang rno ngar che ba'i zur zas khengs yod do/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa/497 ji 'dra zhig la gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa zer ram/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa zhes pa de ni rtsom rig gi grub mtha' 1482

zhig gi ngos nas dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs drug cu par a rir grub/ grub mtha' 'di'i rtsom lugs dang gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi khyad chos gnyis dbar 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan 'ga' res gsar 'gyur gtong spel skabs dang thog rtsom lugs 'di nyid bed spyod byas par brten/ thog mar de nyid rtsom lugs thog gi bcos sgyur zhig tu brtsis nas gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi rtsom lugs sam rim pa mtho ba'i gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi rtsom lugs zhes 'bod/ rjes su zhib 'jug pa 'ga' res dgos mkho mi 'dra bar gzhigs nas sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur gtong spel dang / rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung / ched bris brtsams sgrung zer ba la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs gsar gtod byas/ da lta spyir na grub mtha' 'dir gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa zer ba dang / de'i rtsom lugs gtso bor 6 rtog bzo ma yin ’ pa'i brtsams sgrung ngam rtsom dgag sgrung zhes 'bod la/ rgyal khab 'ga' zhig gis yang der 6 tshad ldan yig cha'i brtsams sgrung ’ yang zer gyi yod/ mig sngar rang rgyal du dar ba'i 6 dngos bris brtsams sgrung ri’dang / de min 65gnad don brtsams sgrung mi ngam ‘ dngos bris gnad don brtsams sgrung mi zer ba sogs kyi brtsams sgrung gi rtsom lugs dang gsar rtsom bya thabs nas bltas na sun 'byin brtsams sgrung dang gnyis su med do/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i grub mtha'i srol gtod pa ni tu'u lu'u mon kha po the yin zhing / 1924lor lu'u dbyi si an na kro'u yi a'o ser lang gsar par skyes nas 1984lor nyi'u yog tu grongs/ dpe skrun dngos po 'ga' zhig thog kho pa ni a ri'i lho phyogs rtsom rig gi tshab mtshon rtsom pa po'i gas su brtsis yod la/ lkog gyur dang / mun nag 'dod sred 1483

bcas kyi nang don 'bri rgyu de kho'i brtsams chos kyi khyad chos su 'dod pa ni dngos gnas kho par ma nyes kha g.yogs byas pa rang yin te/ kho pa ni shin tu sgam brling che ba'i rtsom pa po zhig yin pas snga rjes su o'u heng li'i bya dga' thengs gsum dang / rgyal khab rtsom rig sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug khang gi bya dga' thengs gcig a'e lun pho'i bya dga' thengs gcig a'e smi'i bya dga' thengs gcig thob myong la/ a ri'i pir tshogs kyi kru'u zhi dang a ri'i rgyal khab rtsom rig zhib 'jug khang gi yon hri sogs kyi las 'gan yang 'khur myong yod/ kho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ni sngon rabs las rigs gcig pa'i rjes ma snyeg par rang nyid kyi rtsom rig 'gro lam thog bskyod pa de yin/ khos lo rabs lnga bcu'i rjes su sgo brgyab nas mgron bsu mi byed par rig pa gcig bsgrims kyis grub mtha' sna tshogs la zhib 'jug dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom skor gyi nyams zhib byas/ 1965lor 〈khrag grang 〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung ha cang ring po zhig par du bskrun pa des gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i grub mtha'i rmang gzhi bting bar tshang mas mgrin gcig tu khas len byed kyi yod/ brtsams sgrung der mi gsod gyod don ngo ma zhig bkod yod pa de ni lo lnga drug gi dus yun nang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gting zab byas pa las grub pa zhig red/ brtsams sgrung de'i kha byang phal par 〈rtog dra che ba'i mi gsod kyi gyod don zhig dang de'i rgyu rkyen 〉〉zhes bris la/ rtsom pa pos de'i nang gting zab kyi sand don mang po bton yod pas brtsams sgrung de ni yang a ri'i ‘6gnad don brtsams sgrung mi zhig kyang red ces shod chog brtsams chos des a ri'i rtsom rig las rigs dang spyi tshogs la g.yo 'gul btang bas ma tshad nub phyogs rgyal khab gzhan la'ang shugs rkyen sprad yod/ brtsams sgrung de'i kha byang thad sgyur byas na 1484

〈'khyags grang gi khrag rgyun khrod du gnas pa 〉zhes zer zhing / thog ma'i go don ni mi gsod lag dmar nas nyes gsog gi bya spyod spel skabs kyi ya nga snying rje med pa'i gdug rtsub la zer ba de don dngos thog rtsom pa pos a ri'i rul sungs spyi tshogs la rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyi rgyag gtam brgyab pa zhig red/ 1980lor khos rang gi mtha' ma'i brtsams chos 〈〈mgo bde g.yo can la nyan du 'jug rgyu'i rol mo 〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung thung gras phyogs bsdus shig par du bskrun pa'i nang gi 〈〈'khyer bde'i ro sgam 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos de de tsam ring po med rung de las gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i slob dpon de'i spyir btang gi khyad chos legs par mtshon yod/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i grub mtha' 'grub rgyur da dung thang mu'u a'o er h+phus kyang sub thabs med pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod stabs/mkhas pa 'ga' res gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i srol gtod mes po'i ku'e hwa'i lo 'dab kyi cod pan de kho par g.yogs chog pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ kho pa mig rgyang ring la tshor ba skyen pa dang / yon tan che la nus rtsal mang ba bcas gsar 'gyur 'god po dang / rtsom sgrig pa/ zur za'i ri mo ba/ rtsom pa po dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bcas kyi gcig bsdus phung por grub cing / lo rabs drug cu pa'i snga dus nas dus rabs nyi shu par bskyod tshun gyi a rir gal che'i don snying ldan pa'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' nyag cig ni gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa red ces dril bsgrags byed myong la/ kho pa ni gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs par bskrun byas pa ma zad ched dmigs gleng brjod bkod de klog pa por mtshams sbyor byed mkhan snga shos de yin/ e ha'e e slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan che mo ba we pos 1981lor par du bskrun 1485

pa'i ched rtsom 〈rtog bzo min pa'i rtsom rig ste a ri'i rtsom rig khrod kyi sun 'byin brtsams sgrung 〉zhes pa'i nang thang mu'u sa'o er h+phus gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa shugs cher spel nas a ri'i rtsom rig gi kha phyogs la 'gyur ba btang bas/ a ri'i rtsom rig slar yang dngos yod ring lugs su bskyar log byung ba red ces tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog byas yod/ku'e dbyi ba li si ni gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rkang 'dzin mi sna'i gras shig yin pa dang / da lta a ri'i pir tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa yin/ kho'i shugs rkyen che shos ldan pa'i brtsams chos 〈khyod kyi khyim mtshes kyi chung ma 〉(1979)zhes pa de ni lo brgyad kyi dus yun spyad de a ri'i ‘6'byor 'bring gral rim gyi nyams smad kun spyod ’’gnad don la zhib 'jug byas pa'i nying khu zhig yin pa der shog grangs drug brgya yod/ rtsom pa pos brtsams chos de'i nang a ri ba dkyus ma zhig gis dang thog dwangs gtsang chos lugs pa'i dam nan che ba'i kun spyod lta ba 'dzin pa nas rjes su 4‘'khrig spyod rang dbang mi’gi lta ba ji ltar dang len byas tshul gyi 'pho 'gyur lo rgyus mtshon par byas gshis rtsom pa pos kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi yod tshad 'dor mkhan la zhib 'jug gis kho tsho rang nyid kyi kun spyod 'tsho ba mgyogs myur ngan rul du gyur pa'i gnad don bstan yod/ khos brtsams chos 'di nyid brgyud de mi ser dkyus ma rnams go rtogs sad nas 6‘'khrig spyod gsar brje 〉 zhes pa'i god chag rang bzhin gyi phugs 'bras dang / de dang phyogs mtshungs spyi tshogs dang mi chos/ rig gnas bcas kyi 'brel yod gnad don la do snang chen po yong rgyu'i re ba byas/ brtsams chos 'dir a ri'i rgyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pas gtsigs 'dzin byas shing de'i 'gran zla bral la phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs rig pa'i dpyad yig la de bas mi rnams kyis ha las pa'i 1486

bsngags brjod byed dgos pa zhig yod pa red/grub mtha' 'di'i nang 'di lta bu'i rtsom pa po grags can 'ga' zhig min par khyu zhig yod la/ 'ga' res no man me le yang grub mtha' 'di'i khongs su rtsi bar byed cing / kho tshor rnam mang phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yur za'i grub 'bras thob yod/ mig sngar gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po mi rabs gnyis pa 'tshar longs byung zin pa dang / deng skabs a ri'i rtsom rig dpe deb kyi mtshams sbyor brda khyab nas bltas na/ sun 'byin brtsams sgrung gi gsar rtsom de dpyid dpal bzhad pa ltar 'phel rgyas dang / yar ngo'i zla ltar gong 'phel byung nas rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung dang 44kha gtad do zlar langs pa'i :’gnas su slebs yod pa mthong thub/ 'dzam gling gi gzhi khyon nas bltas na'ang / mig snga'i rgyal khab gtso bo mang por rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung zhes pa'i grub mtha' gsar pa 'di nyid 'grub bzhin yod pa'am yang na grub tshar bas/ mi rnams kyis mgyogs myur de khas len dang / der zhib 'jug mi bya mthu med du gyur yod do/498 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa pos ji ltar brtsams sgrung gi khyab khongs su bskyod pa yin nam/srol rgyun rtsom rig rig gzhung gis rtsom pa pos brtsams chos khrod du rang nyid yib gang thub byed pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa dang / h+phu lo'u pa'e la sna dkon mchog gis ji srid bar mi rnams la zhal gzugs mi ston pa ltar brtsams sgrung bas kyang rang nyid kyi brtsams chos khrod du ngo gdong bstan rgyu med ’’ces pa'i legs bshad grags can zhig yod pa red/ rig gzhung mkhas pa tshos khyad chos 'dir gsar rtsom gyi brgyud rim khrod du rtsom pa po mi 1487

gshis can du mi 'gyur ba zhes 'bod kyi yod/ 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po tshos de las tag tag rgyab kyis phyogs te thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas brtsams sgrung gi khrod du bskyod cing klog pa po dang thad kur gleng mol byed kyi yod/ a ri'i zhib 'jug pa 'ga' res de ni a ri'i spyi tshogs kyi sna rang don ring lugs ker langs byung ba'i mtshon byed ’ cig dang / 66sger gyi rgyu rkyen la shugs snon mi’dang / 64bdag nyid kyi bden pa gsal ston ’ bya phyir yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/ nga tshos khyad chos 'dir gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom brgyud rim khrod kyi mi gshis can du 'gyur ba'i gnad don zhes brjod na chogartsom pa pos rang nyid rang gi brtsams sgrung nang bskyod rgyur bya thabs gtso bo 'ga' zhig spyod pa 'di ltar te/ rigs gcig ni rtsom pa po brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo'i gras shig gi ngos nas 'jug pa dper na/ kha po the'i 〈'khyer bde'i ngo sgam 〉〉zhes pa'i nang rtsom pa po ni brtsams sgrung gi nang du 'jug mkhan snga shos de red la brtsams sgrung gi nang nas kha bral mkhan phyi shos de'ang yin zhing / brtsams sgrung nang gi mi sna ngo ma'i thog nas mi sna gtso bo gzhan zhig ste myul zhib pa ce kho pe po dang ya mtshan g.yo sgyu che ba'i gyod don skor gleng mo byas nas nyams 'gyur btod pa dang / mi sna'i sems khams gsal ston/ byung rim gyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded gtong bcas byas stabs/ rtsom pa po ni brtsams sgrung gi byung rim hril po'i dkyus gcig 'brel gyi grub cha zhig tu gyur pa ma zad/ brtsams sgrung gi sgrig gzhi'i khrod kyi srog shing gi gnas bab kyang bzung yod/ brtsams sgrung gi nang du bskyod thabs gnyis pa ni/ rtsom pa po gang de brtsams sgrung gi bri bya'i mi sna lte bar gyur pa ste brtsams sgrung gi bri bya rtsom pa po'i khyim tshang lo rgyus sam sger gyi /488

'tsho ba'i 'gro lam sogs kyi gnad don yin pa dper na/ 〈a'e kho kha'i rang rnam 〉dang 〈rtsa ba 〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung rnams la rtsom pa pos thad gar rang nyid dam rang gi khyim rgyud kyi sgrung gtam bris par spyi tshogs la g.yo 'gul chen po thebs pa'i phan 'bras thon yod/ rtsom pa po brtsams sgrung nang du bskyod thabs gsum pa ni/ phyogs lhung dang brtse dung shugs che ldan pa'i bcar 'dri ba zhig gi ngos nas brtsams sgrung du 'jug pa de yin/ rtsom pa por 'gran zla bral ba'i mthong thob myong grub kyi dpyad gzhi lag tu lon pa dang / der zhib 'jug dang dbye zhib byas rjes dgos nges kyi chod sdom yang 'jog thub pa byung bas dbang grags ldan pa'i mi sna zhig gi ngos nas don rkyen gyi 'byung rkyen dang don snying rgyas bshad dang / yang na gting zab kyi gnad don bton te klog pa pos khor yug 'jig rten la rtog zhib dang mno sems zhib gtong bya rgyur blo sgo 'byed pa dper na/ kha po the'i 〈(khrag gyang 〉dang / me le'i 〈lag dmar ba'i glu dbyangs/〉 a'o er h+phu'i 〈gru kha'i mi/〉ku'e dbyi ba li si'i 〈khyod kyi khyim mtshes kyi chung ma 〉zer ba la sogs pa'i brtsams chos tshang mar bya thabs 'di bed spyod byas pa lta bu'o/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung nang zhugs te klog pa po dang thad kur gleng mo byed pa 'di ni nga tshos rgyun par shod pa'i gang zag dang po'i ngag sgo'i rtsom 'bri stangs dang 'brel ba yod la dbye ba ldan pa zhig kyang red/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gis kyang gang zag dang po'i ngag sgo'i thog nas gsar rtsom byed chog pa 'di ni de gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba yin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung la gzhi rkang gang zag dang po'i ngag sgo spyod thabs lag bstar byed kyang de nyid gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos su mi gtogs pa de red/ 1489

de ni rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung nang ‘6nga ’ zhes pa'i gang zag dang po'i ngag sgo de rtsom pa pos rtog bzo byas pa zhig yin stabs/ rtsom pa po'i grib gzugs 'dra yod srid kyang ra nga mi dang rtsom pa po gnyis dbyer med gcig 'drar rtsi mi rung bas yin/ rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung nang thad 'jug byed pa ste gsar rtsom khrod du rtsom pa po mi gshis can du 'gyur ba de ni sun 'byin brtsams sgrung gis mi rnams la 66sun 'byin ri gyi khyad chos mngon gsal dod shos sbyin pa de yin pas/ des phan nus ldan pa'i sgo nas brtsams sgrung dang klog pa po'i bar gyi rgyang khad thung du btang ste klog pa por yid ches rang bzhin dang mdza' zhing brtse ba'i tshor snang zhig skye ru 'jug gi yod/ 'on kyang bya thabs gang 'dra zhig yin rung tshang ma kun thub cig ma yin la/ gal te rtsom pa po che ge mo zhig gis klog pa por bltos na rang nyid 6‘ji srid bar yid dbang 'phrog nus dang ldan pa ri’zhig yin par yid ches dang / klog pa po'i dga' sa dang do snang bya yul de thog mtha' bar gsum du rang nyid kyi lus thog tu gcig bsdus byed snyam nas brtsams sgrung khrod kyi don rkyen brjod rgyur snang chung byas na/ de ni gnod 'tshe ldan la nyen kha che ba zhig kyang red/ thabs la mkhas pa'i gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa pos rang nyid brtsams sgrung nang zhugs rjes brtsams sgrung de'i nang gi 'os 'tshams kyi mi sna zhig gi ngos nas de'i dgos 'dun ltar bya ba sgrub pa tsam las lho bsdam rgya'i yul mi las gom pa gang 'da' bar mi nus la/ rtsom pa po brtsams sgrung gi nang du 'jug pa'i thad ku'i dmigs yul yang brtsams chos de nyid dngos 'god can du 'gyur ba bya rgyu de 'ba' zhig yin pa shes kyi yod/ der brten kho tshos dmigs tshad 'di gzhir bzung mi sna dang brtsams chos kyi sgrig gzhi jus 'god byed kyi yod pa 'di ni kho tsho'i brtsams chos la grub 'bras thob 1490

pa'i gal che'i rgyu rkyen zhig red/ don dngos thog dngos 'god rang bzhin zhes pa 'di ni rtsom pa po brtsams sgrung gi nang du zhugs rjes don gnyer bya rgyu'i thog ma'i dmigs tshad tsam yin/ dngos 'god rang bzhin gyi rgyab tu da dung de bas gting zab pa'i dmigs tshad gcig mngon med kyi ngang du gnas yod pa de ni brtsams sgrung du bkod pa'i don rkyen gyi nang nas don snying dang don rkyen dngos su brgyud myong ba'i mi sna'i thad kya'i tshor ba gsal ston bya rgyu de yin te/ gsal por bshad na 64yo bzhi pa'i gnad don zer bar lan 'debs rgyu de red/de ni dngos 'god rang bzhin ni gsar 'gyur brtsams chos la ma mthar dgos pa'i re ba zhig yin mod/ 647’’bzhi par lan 'debs rgyu ni da gzod rtsom rig brtsams chos rang la yod dgos nges kyi don gnad cig red/gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi rtsom rig 'bri na 46sag53 sag7010 gagatakhub ’(4 don gang yin pa dang / gnas gang du yod pa/ dus gang yin pa mi’)bcas 667sa’'di gsum la lan brgyab pas 'thus mod/ 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pas da dung ‘6457 ’(‘rgyu mtshan ci 1)zhes pa ste 4‘spo’’bzhi par lan rgyag dgos pas/ 'di ltar gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos de gsar 'gyur brtsams chos 'ar+sha'o zhig ma yin par rtsom rig brtsams chos su 'gyur yod pa 'di ni ngo bo'i thog gi 'gyur ldog chen po zhig red/ ‘4spo ribazhi pa yod med kyi gnad don 'di ni rtsom rig brtsams chos dang gsar 'gyur brtsams chos gnyis kyi gal 'gangs che ba'i dbye gzhi zhig yin/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa pos 'bad brtson chen pos 46yin/’bzhi par lan 'debs kyi yod cing / brtsams chos mang pos tshad gzhi 1 491

nges can thog spyi tshogs kyi ngo bor 'brel ba byas shing deng skabs nub phyogs spyi tshogs kyi dngos don ther 'don cung zab mo byas pa dper na/ kha po the'i (khyer bde'i ro sgam 〉zhes pa'i nang / myul zhib pa rgan gras ce kho le pos 'brog bdag chen po pa'o po khule en lag dmar ba yin pa rtsad chod kyang phyogs gang ci'i 'gog rkyen phog dus yun lo bdun ring gyod don rtsad gcod kyi bya ba sgrub kyin sgrub kyin dka' khag je cher 'gro la tha na kho'i brtse grogs kyang lkog gsod phog pa red/ skabs 'dir rtsom pa po kha po thes myul zhib pa rgan gras ce kho ye po'i grogs po blos thub zhig gi ngos nas brtsams sgrung nang zhugs shing don rkyen dngos su brgyud myong mkhan mi sna'i zur tshad nas skyi 'jigs kyag kyog che ba'i gyod don de nyid gson nyams ldan par brjod de 4‘spo’ gong ma gsum la lan brgyab pa ma zad/ dpe mtshon khungs btsan brgyud a rir ba spu las mang ba'i bca' khrims yod kyang nyes gsog gi gyod don sngar bzhin chag med 'phar snon 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen ci yin gsal bshad kyis 46so’’bzhi par yang lan btab/ kha po the lta bu'i cung legs pa'i sgo nas ‘64sa’bzhi par lan 'debs mkhan phul byung rtsom pa po nyin mo'i skar ma ltar nyung ba de 'dra min la/ kho tsho'i zhib mo'i blo las phyung ba'i brtsams chos ni dngos yod ring lugs kyi phul byung rtsom pa po'i sor rtse las grol ba'i rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung dang phan tshun spel zla'i tshul du mi rnams spro sems skye dgos pa zhig yod do/499 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos rtsom lugs la khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos la phyogs gnyis thad 1492

kyi sbrags ma'i rang bzhin ldan yod par brten 64lo rgyus kyi brtsams sgrung dang /brtsams sgrung gi lo rgyus mi’su rtsi chog 'on kyang dang thog mi rnams kyis rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung 'di rigs 46ra min lug min ’’zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byas te rtsom lugs ji 'dra zhig tu gtogs pa'i skor rigs dbye bya thabs ma byung ba dper na/ lo rgyus smra ba pos de nyid brtsams sgrung yin pas rtsom rig gi khongs su gtogs shing lo rgyus kyi brtsams chos min par 'dod/ 'on kyang rtsom rig nas de nyid gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi rtsom yig cig yin pa'i cha nas lo rgyus brtsams chos kyi khongs su gtogs pa las rig rtsal gsar rtsom zhig yin pa khas mi len pa lta bu red/ lo rgyus kyi brtsams chos yin na rtog bzo mi rung ba dang / rtsom rig brtsams chos la rtog bzo med thabs med pa zhig yin pa 'di ni spyir btang gi rtsa don yin pa smos mi dgos/gnad 'gag ni gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom lugs kyi khyad chos la ji ltar lta dgos pa de yin/ don dngos thog rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung la gcig nas lo rgyus brtsams chos rtsom lugs kyi khyad chos ldan la/ gnyis nas rtsom rig brtsams chos rtsom lugs kyi khyad chos kyang ldan yod pas/ rtsom lugs sbrags ma'i khyad chos ldan pa 'di 'dra ni tag tag gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi gal che'i mtshon tshul zhig yin/rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom lugs kyi sbrags ma'i rang bzhin 'di ni kha po the mi sger gyi gsar gtod cig min par/ dang thog gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i grub mtha'i gsar rtsom bya thabs thad kyi ngo bo nyis ldan gyis thag bcad pa zhig ste/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom pa pos rtsom 'bri skabs gsar 'gyur gtong spel te brtsams sgrung can du bsgyur pa'am 1493

brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom de gsar 'gyur gtong spel can du bsgyur pas yin/ra can gnyis ’’brgyud gsar 'gyur dang brtsams sgrung / lo rgyus dang rtsom rig bcas bar gyi nang gnas 'brel ba gsal ston gyis/ bkag sdom gyi tshul du gnas pa'i phyogs gnyis kyi khyab khongs phan tshun mthun sbyor yong ba byas te/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung de de gnyis sbrel byed kyi zam pa lta bur gyur pa red/ 'di ni rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom lugs dpe gsar dang mi'i yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gnad 'gag thug sa de yin/ de min/ gsar 'gyur dang / brtsams sgrung / lo rgyus dang rtsom rig bcas ni phan tshun yongs su 'gal zlar langs pa zhig min par 'gal zla gcig 'du'i 'brel bar grub pa zhig yin la/ de tsho tshang ma rtsom pa po'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i zin bris dang mtshon tshul zhig yin pa 'dir gsar 'gyur ring 'u gas gsar pa'i rtsom pa pos go ba cung zab tsam len thub kyi yod/ rtsom rig gi lo rgyus nas bltas na/ dngos yod ring lugs brtsams sgrung gis ha cang ring ba'i dus yun nang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa'i thog nas spyi tshogs kyi gsar 'gyur gtong spel byed kyi yod/ gsar 'gyur ni dma' rim gyi brtsams sgrung yin la/ brtsams sgrung ni mtho rim gyi gsar 'gyur yin pa dang / lo rgyus ni las snon ma bgyis pa'i rtsom rig dang / rtsom rig ni zhib mo'i blos las snon bgyis pa'i lo rgyus yin/ 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos la de rnams phung po gcig tu grub par byas yod/ de nas rtsom lugs 'di'i sbrags ma'i rang bzhin dang 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi srol rgyun gnyis bar la'ang 'byung rtsa'i 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin te/a ri'i rtsom rig de rang la gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi srol rgyun ldan yod/a ri'i rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom pa pos ma kho phu'u wun dang / yu'e 14 94

han li te'i brtsams chos la mos bkur chen po byed pa dang / a ri phud da dung the lu'o lu'o phu'u dang / ha ta'e/ ti keng si/ si thang ta/ par kra kho/ thu'o si thu'o ye h+phu si ci/ li'e chu thu'o er si tha'e lta bu'i rtsom pa po rnams la'ang do snang chen pos zhib 'jug gis kho tsho'i nyams myong dang len byas yod/ mtha' ma da dung bstan dgos pa zhig la/ sbrags ma'i rang bzhin gyi rtsom lugs te rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung khrod du don brjod kyi nus par shugs snon je cher thebs yod/ de snga nub phyogs deng rabs ring lugs kyi bang rim dang gtam rgyud sogs ma 'dod sna shu rgyag pa'i rtsom srol rnams rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung nang slar gso byung nas/ nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi rtsom rig nang cha tshang ba'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim 'god srol med par gyur nas lo mang song rjes da lam bskyar du de 'dra'i rtsom srol thon par klog pa por lo mang bral ba'i grogs rnying bskyar 'phrad byung ba lta bu'i mdza' brtse'i tshor snang zhig byung ba'i snang tshul thog nas/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung sbrags ma'i rang bzhin dang nye lam lo shas tshun la nub phyogs 'jig rten du dpa' nyams bskyar spel gyis thon pa'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gnyis kyi spyi'i 'phel phyogs gcig gyur yin pa ma zad/ de'i zhib phra'i mtshon tshul gyi gras shig kyang yin pa mi rnams blo mos yid ches thebs dgos pa'i sgo nas legs par mtshon yod do/500 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa dang gnas zhu'i rtsom rig gnyis dbar mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ci yod dam/gnas zhu'i rtsom rig dang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos gnyis 'dra sa'i gnas mang la khrag rgyud gcig pa'i gcen gcung lta bu'i 1495

'brel ba grub pas/ 'ga' res de gnyis rtsom rig gi rnam grangs gcig tu ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar dngos 'brel thun mong gi rang bzhin shin tu mang ba dper na/ gnyis shar gsar 'gyur gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ gnyis gas mi ngo ma dang don rkyen ngo ma 'bri ba dang / gnyis nas klog pa por mdza' zhing brtse ba'i tshor snang zhig dang yid ches kyi rang bzhin zhig sbyin par byed pa lta bu'o/ 'on kyang 'di gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang yod bden yin/dang thog grub pa'i dus tshod la dbye ba yod de gnas zhu'i rtsom rig ni gcig shos las thon snga zhing dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs sum cu par mtho rlabs su bskyod zin/ 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom rig ni lo rabs drug cu'i dus dkyil du gzhi nas byung ba dang / da lta yang dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus rabs su gnas yod/ de nas gnyis ku'i tha snyad kyi go don mi 'dra ste/ gnas zhu'i rtsom rig ni rtsom rig gi lus shig la go mod/ gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa ni rtsom rig gi lus shig la go ba tsam ma zad gtso bo rtsom rig gi grub mtha' zhig la zer ba yin/ yang de nas rtsom lugs kyi thog nas gleng na/ gnas zhu'i rtsom rig ni rtsom rig rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur gtong spel gyi khyab khongs su gtogs shing / gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom rig ni brtsams sgrung ste rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung zhig red/rtsom lugs kyis rgyas bcad pa'i 'og gnas zhu'i rtsom rig gis spyir na mig snga'i dngos yod kyi brjod bya 'ba' zhig 'god pa ma zad rtog bzo'i rigs rtsa ba nas byed mi chog 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung ni gnas zhu'i rtsom rig las rang dbang che bas/ gcig nas mig snga'i gsar 'gyur gyi brjod bya 'god chog la/ gnyis nas lo rgyus thog gi brjod bya rnying pa'ang 'bri chog pa ma zad/ mi ngo ma dang don rkyen ngo 1496

ma 'god pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng 'os 'tshams kyi rtog bzos kha gsab kyang byed chog gi yod/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung la rtog bzo ma yin pa'i brtsams sgrung yang zer mod/ rtog bzo rtsa ba nas med pa min te mi ngo ma dang don rkyen ngo ma 'bri rgyu gtso bor byed pa dang rtog bzo gtso bor byed pa'am yang na rbad de rtog bzo byed pa'i brtsams sgrung bar gyi khyad pa ra tsam zhig yin pa 'di ni gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i gsang ba gzhan zhig red/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gi rig gzhung ba dge rgan che mo we pos 64rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gi rtsom pa po'i dmigs yul ni sgrung gi dbye mtshams rgya cher gtong rgyu min par/ rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung dang nye bar bcar thub pa bya rgyu de red mi’ces skad cha tshig gcig gi thog nas gsang ba mthil brdol byas yod pa ltar/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung 'bri mkhan mkhas pa tshang mas rang gi brtsams chos nang shin tu mngon med dang gzab gzab nan nan gyi sgo nas rtog bzo byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang klog pa pos ha cang tshor dka' la/ ci ste tshor shes byung ba'i dbang du btang rung klog pa por don dngos dang mi 'tshams pa'i tshor snang yong rgyu lta ci de las ldog ste rtsom pa po'i lugs mthun gyi mtshon thabs dang khyad 'phags kyi rtsal yon la dag snang byung nas mdzes dpyod kyi longs spyod cig tu 'gyur gyi yod/ 'di dang don dngos dang mi 'tshams pa'i gnas zhu'i rtsom rig klog pa gnyis bsdur na khyad par chen po yod pa zhig red/ spyir btang byas na rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gi rtsom pa pos rtag tu spyod pa'i rtog bzo'i bya thabs ni rigs gnyis te mi sna gtso bo dang don rkyen tshang ma ngo ma yin pa ma zad yongs khyab kyi don snying yang ldacha yod/ rtsom pa pos mi dang don rkyen thad kur 'god pa'i khar cha shas ches nyung shas kyi zhib cha kha gsab dang byung rim thad kyi bcos sgrig phran bu bgyis 1497

pa dper na/ kha po the'i 〈khrag grang 〉dang / me le'i 〈lag dmar ba'i glu dbyangs 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos ni bya thabs 'di 'dra spyad de bris pa zhig red la/ grub mtha' 'di'i rtsom pa po'i snga dus gsar rtsom gyi khrod du bya thabs 'di rgyun du spyod kyi yod/ bya thabs gzhan zhig ni/ rtsom pa pos rtog bzo'i mi sna dang don rkyen khrod du zhugs te rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung de nyid las rtog bzo ma yin pa'i brtsams sgrung gi phan 'bras thon pa byed kyi yod/'on kyang rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom pa pa pos mi sna dang don rkyen rtog bzo byed pa'i skabs su yang dmigs yul gcig dam por bzung ba ni don dngos dang kha mi bral ba byed pa de yin/ rtog bzo bgyis pa'i mi sna dang don rkyen zhes pa rnams kyang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang gzhir grub zin pa zhig yin pa las phal cher gzhir grub pa zhig ma yin/ 'on kyang kha gram drags pa'i rkyen gyis rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po tshos mi sna dang don rkyen de rnams gang yong ci yong gi sgo nas gcig bsdus kyis sgrig sbyor bkod sgrig byed kyi yod/ kha po the'i 〈'khyer bde'i ro sgam 〉zhes pa ni bya thabs 'di spyad de bris pa zhig red/ spyir na brtsams sgrung zhig la cha mtshon na/6 mi ngo ma dang don rkyen ngo ma ri bcu cha bdun dang don dngos dang 'tshams pa'i rtog bzo bcu cha gsum yod na/ klog pa po'i mos mthun thob rgyu ma zad de 'dra'i brtsams chos la rtog bzo ma yin pa'i brtsams sgrung ngam yang na dngos 'god brtsams sgrung zhes zer gyi yod do/501 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pa'i blo stobs de phyogs gang gi thad nas mtshon gyi yod dam/gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pa'i blo stobs de thog mar 1498

deng rabs ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal thad 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur nas mtshon gyi yod/ lo rabs drug cu pa'i dus dkyil nas bdun cu'i bar/ nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i sgyu rtsal lam yang na gdong len smra ba gsar par 'bod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis skabs der thams cad las rgyal ba'i khyad 'phags kyi gnas bab bzung zhing gdong len smra ba gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal dang rig gzhung la dad bkur bya rgyu de dus bstun dar bzo che shos shig tu gyur nas/ ‘4dngos yod ring lugs 1 de nyid bed med kyi dngos zog rnying hrul zhig dang 'dra bar logs su bskyur ba dang / ‘ rnying hrul nya dngos yod ring lugs kyi sgrig srol yod tshad gtor dgos zhes pa'i tsha 'god byas/ 'on kyang gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pas ‘‘dar che ba'i grub mtha'i ’ rig gnas pa zhig byed mi 'dod la/ kho tshor gdong len smra ba gsar pas rtsom rig khyab khongs su spel ba'i bya spyod kyis god chag gi gnod 'tshe skyel rgyu las spyi tshogs 'tsho ba ji bzhin mtshon rgyur phan thogs til 'bru tsam med pa'i nges shes rnyed stabs gdong len smra ba gsar pa'i bya spyod la sun 'byin gyi rnam 'gyur bzung nas mdung rtse kha sprod kyis ‘4spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod ring lugs slar gso ’’dang /spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod ring lugs de gsar rtsom gyi tshad gzhir brtsis nas tshul 'chal smra ba dang / rtog pa rang yan pa/ nag po'i dgod bro smra ba sogs kyi lta bar sun 'byin dang / rtsom rig gis rtsom pa po bdag nyid mtshon dgos la/ 66dpe deb ’’(305 )kyi sna brda rtags sgyu rtsal ’’zhes par don snying til 'bru tsam med pa/ nges par duspyi tshogs kyi dngos yod mtshon dgos pa dang / rtsom rig la spyi tshogs kyi don snying ldan dgos pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byas pa 'di ni shin tu nas rtsa 'gangs che ba zhig red/ gsar 'gyur ring ༷/gas gsar paci/ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gis rtsom rig rnal 1499

mar 'bod pa'i rtog bzo'i brtsams sgrung gi tshab byas pa de ni ‘‘dngos yod ring lugs kyi lam phyogs rgyun 'dzin sgro dang / deng rabs nub phyogs kyi mtha' dpyod dngos yod ring lugs kyi snying stobs mtshon pa zhig yin par da lta rig gzhung bas khas len gyi yod/ gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pas a ri'i gal 'gangs che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don mang por rtsad sngog byas yod pa dper na/ a ri'i spyi tshogs ni nyes gsog pa thon sa'i 'byung rtsa yin pa'i skor dang / a ris we the nam la btsan 'dzul byed pa dang / hru'e mon gyi don rkyen/ spyi tshogs kyi drag shugs/ 'khrig spyod rang dbang / 'dod sred zer ba sogs la ngo rgol byed pa bcas 66dus bab dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas rtsom rgyag pa mi zhes pa bzhin du lag len nang zhugs yod/kho tshos rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi zhib phra'i rgyu cha bdams gses byed skabs a rir dbang cha 'dzin mkhan 6 khengs dregs che la rdzig nyams dod pa'i mi sna mi’de 'drar phog thug gtong phod pa dper na/ sa'e mi'o er hor hris de snga zur lnga'i khang chen te a ri'i rgyal srung pu'u la gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi las ka byed myong yod/ 'on kyang 1968lor khos 〈'bu phra'i mtshon cha ste a ri'i gsang ba'i go mdzod 〉ces pa'i rtsom yig spel te zur lnga'i khang chen la thad kur mdung rtse gtad par/ a ri'i gzhung phyogs dang dmangs khrod gang sar g.yo 'gul chen po btang zhing 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan dag gis kyang don der shin tu do snang byas/ 1970lor khos slar yang 〈smi la dbyi te ste dmar gsod chen po dang de'i phugs 'bras skor gyi snyan zhu 〉zhes pa'i rtsom zhig spel te zur lnga'i khang chen gyi gzhi rgya che ba'i dmar gsod kyi jus gzhi gzhan zhig ther 'don byas pas srid gzhung gi phyogs ga byed 'di byed med pa lta bu'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa red/ de bzhin ma'e khor a'e lun gyis 1500

1973lor 〈a ri'i dpyad mtshams 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig 'grems spel byas te skabs de'i a ri'i tsung thang gzhon pa a ko nyi'u la mdung rtse gtad pa sogs lta bu'o/ de min gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pas da dung srog bsdos kyi nyen khar mi 'dzems par mthong thos myong grub kyi dpyad gzhi lag tu lon thabs byed pa'i nang hong ther thang phu'u hreng ni mtshon byed mi sna zhig yin te/ khos thengs mang srog dmar 'ben 'dzugs kyi sgo nas brin kha rgyug pa'i gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri byas stabs kho pa ni ngag rgyun khrod kyi lkog gyur can gyi dpa' bo'i mi sna zhig tu gyur te a ri'i gzhon nu mang pos kho par dad bkur byed kyi yod/ lo rabs drug cu'i dus dkyil du a ri'i shar rgya mtsho'i 'gram du sna lha'i pho nya ’’yin zer mkhan sbag sbag zhon te 'phrog bcom byed pa'i jag tshogs shig yod pa de ni rtsa 'dzugs dam zhing bya spyod dpog dka' ba dang / 'gro 'ong bya 'phur ba lta bur myur ba zhig yin pas/ a ri'i gzhung phyogs ci bya gtol med du gyur/ 'on kyang skabs der thang phu'u hreng ni dus deb khang zhig gi gsar 'gyur 'god mi yin pas stag tshang du 'dzul nas dngos su rtag dpyad zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa bzhin/ nyin zhig gyon bzo phran bu bsgyur nas sbag sba/ ga cig zhon te shar rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi rgya lam thog thon/ mtha' ma ‘4lha'i pho nya ’ tsho dang glo bur du thug 'phrad byung nas jag tshang du zhugs te gnas tshul rnams brtag dpyad byas/ rjes su 6‘lha'i pho nya mi tshos dus deb nang nas khos spel ba'i gsar 'gyur mthong skabs da gzod kho'i gnas tshul ngo ma shes rtogs byung ste kho gsod rgyur thag bcad/ 'on kyang ‘‘lha'i pho nya nya’tsho phyir bzhud rjes thang phu'u hreng nyen kha nas bskyabs te bar chad chen po las thar thub pa byung bas/khos de bas jag tshogs de tsho ther 'don gyi rtsom 'bri rgyu'i ched sems 1501

btsugs/ skabs der 'ga' res ‘‘gal te khyod kyis deb de par skrun byas tshe ngas khyod lnga lam du brdzang rgyu yin 〉’zhes pa'i 'jigs skul gyi yi ge springs kyang sgyu rtsal pas rang gi shi gson gyi gnad don la snga sa nas snang 'jog byas med pas/ 1966lor khos yid shin tu gdung ba'i mi rigs kyi skyo gar brtse dung las bris pa'i rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung 〈dmyal ba'i pho nya 〉zhes pa de 'grems spel byas/ ha cang co bro ba zhig la/ brtsams chos de par du bskrun rjes rtsom rig las rigs dang rgyal khab kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi don chen zhig tu gyur nas 4‘lu'o dbyang khul gyi shog gong che ba'i 〉〉dpe ltar rgyal yongs khyon du 'tshang ka shig shig ngang thang phu'u hreng gis 46dmyal bar rta’brtol ba'i ngag rgyun gtam rgyud khyab/ ngan rgu tshang ba'i 44lha'i pho nya ’ dmar rjen du bton pas rkang pa 'dzugs thabs med par ma 'thab rang 'thor gyis rtsa brlag tu song / gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pa'i blo stobs de da dung gsar gtod byed phod pa'i thog nas kyang mtshon gyi yod de/ kho tshos blo rgya chen pos rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs rig pa/ lo rgyus rig pa/ gsar 'gyur rig pa sogs zung 'brel byed pa dang / rtsom rig gi thabs rtsal dang snyan ngag ri mo/ glog brnyan/ srid don dpyad gtam/ thol byung rtsom sogs zung 'brel gyis 44brtsams sgrung dang mi 'dra la brtsams sgrung las rnam par rgyal ba'i ’ rtsom dgag brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom byas te/ rtsom rig gi khyab khongs gsar pa phye yod do/502 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa po'i shes yon de phyogs gang gi thad nas mtshon gyi yod dam/blo stobs dang shes yon gnyis ni sgyu rtsal pa'i gshog pa cha gcig yin 1502

pas gcig ma tshang na'ang 'grig thabs med/ gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsom pa ni shes yon la thogs pa med cing rig gnas kyi bang rim cung mtho la ha lam tshang mar cha tshang zhing rig tshan mang ba'i mtho rim gyi slob gso thob myong ba dang / shes yon gyi gsog tshad phun sum tshogs la zab pa/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul shes rtogs yod la bya dngos gsar pa dang bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun gsar par tshor ba skyen po yod pa/ mi mang che bas tshags par dang dus deb kyi gsar 'gyur 'god po dang rtsom sgrig pa byed myong la/ rgyal khab mang por bskyod myong bas mthong thos yangs la shes rgya che ba dang / mig mthong lag zin gyi myong cha cung che la/ gnad don la lta skabs mig rgyang ring ba bcas yod/ kho tsho klad pa dkrugs rgyur dga' zhing bsam gzhigs byed mkhas pa dang / gsar rtsom thad 'bad brtson chen pos rang lugs gsar gtod kyis rang nyid kyi nyams 'gyur grub pa byed kyi yod/kho tsho lo na gzhon zhing rtsol shugs ldan pa dang / spyi tshogs gnad don gyi tshur snang mgyogs pa/ 'bad brtson chen pos spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnad don dam 'dzin gyis grub 'bras thon mgyogs la/ mi mang po lo nyi shu pa'i g.yas g.yon nas ming grags 'phel te tha na rtsom rig las rigs su g.yo 'gul btang yod pa/ kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang che ba 'byor ldan gral rim 'bring chung gi khyim tshang nas skyes shing rang gi 'bad 'thab la brten nas grub 'bras thob pa dang / 'byor chen gral rim gyi dbang sgyur dang mig snga'i rul sungs kyi ma rtsa ring lugs lam lugs la yid gtan nas rangs kyi med stabs/ rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang 'brel ba cung mang ba la sogs pa'i khyad chos de rnams kho tsho'i brtsams chos las mtshon gyi yod pa ma zad/de dag gis kho tsho'i brtsams chos kyi dge mtshan dang zhan cha'i phyogs kyang 1503

gtan la phab yod/a me ri kha ni tshad mtho'i 'gran rtsod kyi tshong las spyi tshogs shig yin pas/ de ni sgyu rtsal pa'i shes yon 'don spel bya rgyur phan thogs med pa zhig red/ sgyu rtsal pas 'tsho gnas kyi ched du phyogs lhung ngan pa 'ga' zhig dang 'tshams thabs sam tha na 'dod bstun mi bya mthu med yin pa dper na/drag shugs dang 'khrid spyod skor shugs che 'bri ba dang / shes yon la thogs pa med pa'i grags can rtsom pa po me les kyang rtsom rgyag pa ni ‘6dngul thob phyir mi’yin pa khas mi len ka med byung bas mtshon yod/ khos tshor snang zab mo'i ngang nas ‘6dang thog nga rtsom rig ma gtogs bsam rgyu med/ yin na'ang da lta ngas bsams pa ni dngul yin/ a tsi/ bkra ma shis pa zhig la da lta nga tshong las rang bzhin gyi rtsom pa po zhig chags pa 'dir nga blo pham chen po 'dug gang yin zhe na/ tshong las rang bzhin gyi rtsom pa por dga' snang zhes pa gleng thabs bral 'dug ri’ces bshad yod/ me le lta bu'i rtsom pa po yang de 'dra'i bkra ma shis pa zhig yin gyur na rtsom pa po gzhan rnams ji 'dra yin min bsam shes los thub/ rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gis 46rtog bzo ma yin pa mi dang ‘‘dngos bris 〉’don gnyer byed drags te dpe mtshon gyi brjod bya bdams gses bya rgyur snang chung shor nas dpe mtshon can dor bar brten/mtha' ma 64kha shor dbyings zhugs 〉 kyis rang byung ring lugs kyi srol rnying gi dra bar tshud nas thar thub kyi med pa red/ de'i thog nas nga tshor blang bya bton pa ni/ gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i grub mtha'i brtsams chos klog skabs nges par du dbye zhib kyi thog nas rang rgyal gyi dngos don dang mi 'tshams pa'am snyigs ro rnams dor te spang blang gi tshul mi ldog pa zhig byas na/ da gzod 65gzhan gyi dge mtshan shin tu chung na'ang / rang la phan na khengs pa bskyungs te len ’’zhes pa'i nus pa thon thub pa bcas lags so/ 1504
